overview.location: Morrisville, Wake County, North Carolina — between Raleigh and Durham, next to Research Triangle Park (RTP) and William B. Umstead State Park. The airport's mailing addresses are in Morrisville (e.g., Cell Lot at 1000 Trade Drive, Morrisville, NC 27560).
overview.passengerVolume: About 15.5 million passengers in 2024 (record, per RDU's 2024 year-end release); third-party data shows ~15.65 million in 2025 — verify against an official RDU release before citing 2025.
overview.distinction: North Carolina's second-busiest airport (after Charlotte) and the gateway to the Research Triangle (Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Cary, RTP). The primary runway 5L-23R is being replaced (~$400M program, groundbreaking Oct 2023, completion expected 2029).
overview.owner: Raleigh-Durham Airport Authority (jointly appointed by the cities of Raleigh and Durham and Wake and Durham counties — verify)
overview.totalConcourses: Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 (Terminal 2 has Concourses C and D — verify)

runwayDetails.length: Replacement runway 10,639 ft, built 537 ft from the current alignment; old runway becomes a taxiway

overview.dominantAirline: verify — Delta, American and Southwest are the largest carriers by seats (verify current shares)
overview.metroAccess: No rail. GoTriangle Route 100 and the RDU Shuttle serve the airport. Stops: Terminal 1 between Zone 2 and Zone 3; Terminal 2 between Zone 6 and Zone 7.
overview.peopleMover: None. Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 are separate buildings across the central parking garage — walk between them (verify walk time).

Off-site via Triply: hotel park-and-fly lots in Morrisville, Cary and Durham/RTP from ~$7.66/day with free shuttle.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: ParkRDU Economy shuttle 24/7 every 20 minutes; ParkRDU Express 24/7 trunk-to-terminal shuttle with luggage help. Off-site: all five Triply lots are hotel lots with free shuttles using the red curb hotel-shuttle zones outside each terminal — call the hotel after you collect bags. Only Sheraton Imperial runs 24/7 (hourly); Embassy Suites (4 AM-12 AM), Quality Inn & Suites (4 AM-12 AM), Cambria (4:15 AM-12 AM) and Microtel (4:15 AM-11:45 PM) do not run overnight.
distanceFromCity: About 15 miles northwest of downtown Raleigh and about 12 miles southeast of downtown Durham via I-40 (verify exact mileage). Located in Morrisville, Wake County, next to Research Triangle Park.

keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: Every Triply RDU lot sits 1.7-3.2 miles from the terminals, and the cheapest (~$7.66-8.24/day) is roughly half the $14.50 ParkRDU Economy rate.
